description: List email addresses excluded from open and click tracking. Returns up to 1000 records per call.

email.description: Optional email filter. Returns tracking opt-outs matching this address.

end_time.description: Only opt-outs created at or before this time (ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-08-31T23:59:59Z).

last_id.description: Pagination cursor — the `last_id` from the previous response, to fetch the next page.

start_time.description: Only opt-outs created at or after this time (ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-08-01T00:00:00Z).

name: list-tracking-opt-outs
